title: ULS Shader
description: A lightweight Iris shader focused on performance, vibrant visuals, and Intel UHD compatibility.
body:
This is a lightweight shader focused on performance while still looking good. This shader makes the game look a lot more visually apleasing while still running extremely well e.g 
(vanilla with performance mods: 60+fps. Performance mods with ULS: 50+ fps)

This is what my shader adds:
- glowing torches
- warm colors
- vibrant colors
- Optimized for Integrated graphics (tested and developed using intel uhd graphics)
- 50+ fps on intel integrated graphics
- Iris and fabric compatible (yet to test optifine)
- supports dynamic lighting mods
- improved atmosphere at day/night

Developed and tested on a hp probook 440 g7 with intel uhd graphics
Development asstiance provided by chatgpt

Aimed for people with lower hardware such as integrated graphics

Approved on curse forge https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/shaders/usl-shader
